clips.title: The story
paras: Guard Berton in Lakeshire is pressing for Targorr the Dread's execution. The Blackrock orc remains in Stormwind Stockade despite his sentence, while political delays keep justice out of reach.

Targorr the Dread earned his name in the Redridge Mountains, where he served as supreme executioner under General Gath'Ilzogg, chieftain of the Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep. Even among the invaders, his cruelty was notorious. He oversaw the torture and execution of many Redridge defenders. After his capture, Stormwind sent him to its high-security prison, the Stormwind Stockade, and condemned him to die for his crimes against the realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner. His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards. Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim. Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die. Yet something is amiss. One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution. I am sure foul play is in the works.
Put an end to Targorr the Dread, friend. Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade? I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom. He was sentenced to die, friend, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Targorr the Dread has finally met his fate. I for one am glad to hear the beast now knows what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death's ruthless grip. You have done well, friend. Sometimes the truest justice can only be found outside the courtroom and beyond the clouded vision of politics.
